summary_md: **Aaron (Youshen) Lim ([@youshenlim](https://x.com/youshenlim/status/2115602099719352609))** summarizes **The Trinity**, a framework that reorganizes multimodal agent training around shared capabilities rather than task categories, with three automated roles that generate simplified environments, evolve reusable modules and route tasks, reporting a 34-point gain.
relevance: Capability-driven recursive self-improvement for multimodal agents.
